design_notes.scammer_ecosystem: The square around the Astronomical Cock-Up is a finely-tuned tourist extraction machine. Each scammer has a specific role, and they all know each other - occasionally nodding or making eye contact across the crowd. They are professionals.
design_notes.comedy_principle: Players see through every scam instantly. Bros fall for all of them enthusiastically.
design_notes.recurring_appearances: Several of these NPCs appear throughout the game in other cities, creating callback humor.

clothing: Slightly too-nice jacket (trying to look official)
Lanyard with laminated card (says nothing official)
distinguishing_features: Too-friendly smile that doesn't reach eyes
appearance.sprite_notes: Should look almost-but-not-quite official, like a tour guide who forgot his uniform

personality.motivation: This is his job. He's actually pretty good at it.
personality.internal_monologue: Americans are easy. They WANT to believe they're getting insider access.

scam_details.service_offered: Prime viewing spots for the clock show
scam_details.what_he_delivers: A spot behind a pillar with completely blocked view

approach.line: Americans! You want best view? I have prime spots. Only €10 each. See everything.
approach.delivery: Conspiratorial whisper, like sharing a secret

during_scam.leading_to_spot: This way, this way. Very exclusive area.
during_scam.at_blocked_spot: Here. Best spot. Very authentic viewing experience.

if_questioned.about_pillar: The pillar is part of the experience. Locals view from here.

schedule.peak_activity: Every hour on the half-hour (30 mins before clock show)

connections.relationship: Professional colleagues, occasional nod of acknowledgment
connections.territory_respect: Each has their own scam, no overlap

recurring_appearances.note: Only operates in Debaucheryville - this is his turf

clothing: Hotel bathrobe (beige, passing for monk robe at a glance)
distinguishing_features: Hotel logo VISIBLE on bathrobe if you look closely (easter egg)
Fake serene expression that cracks into salesman mode
appearance.sprite_notes: Should be obviously a guy in a bathrobe to players, but bros see 'authentic European monk'

personality.archetype: Retired Con Man Finding Easy Mark
personality.motivation: Easy money, mild entertainment watching tourists believe anything
personality.internal_monologue: I can't believe this still works. Every time.

scam_details.what_he_delivers: Vague hand gestures and fake Latin
scam_details.blessing_text: Lorem ipsum spiritu sanctu... party hardy... amen.
scam_details.bradley_interpretation: That's Latin for 'good vibes.' I recognize it.

approach.line: My sons. You seek the clock's wisdom. For small donation, I bless your journey. Ancient ritual.

blessing.words: Lorem ipsum spiritu sanctu... party hardy... amen.
blessing.timing: Drawn out for dramatic effect, about 15 seconds

post_blessing.line: Go in peace. And check out my cousin's wine cart.
post_blessing.delivery: Breaks character slightly, genuine sales referral

if_questioned.about_robe: This is traditional... uh... local monk attire.
if_questioned.about_latin: Ancient dialect. Very sacred. You wouldn't understand.

schedule.breaks: Takes cigarette breaks behind pillar every 2 hours
schedule.location_in_square: Center-left, positioned to intercept blessed scam victims toward wine cart

connections.kickback: Gets 10% of wine sales from referred tourists

easter_eggs.description: Hotel Marriott logo visible on bathrobe collar if player examines closely
Can be seen smoking behind pillar during off-hours, bathrobe open over regular clothes

other_locations.role: Selling 'opera blessings' in slightly nicer bathrobe
other_locations.dialogue_callback: Ah! My blessed Americans! You want blessing for opera? Same price, more culture.

distinguishing_features: Cart covered in mystical-looking symbols (actually just random squiggles)
Wine bottles that look fancy (boxed wine inside)
appearance.sprite_notes: Classic tourist trap vendor energy, cart should look mystical but cheap on close inspection

personality.motivation: Supports extended family through wine scam, takes pride in volume
personality.internal_monologue: Sixty euros a bottle! They don't even taste it first!

scam_details.claimed_properties: Infused with temporal energy, makes you magnetic to ladies
scam_details.actual_product: €3 boxed wine poured into fancy bottles

approach.line: You have been blessed! Now you drink the clock wine. Infused with temporal energy. Very popular with ladies at clubs.
approach.delivery: Rapid-fire enthusiasm, barely lets customer respond

sales_pitch.hook: The clock energy, it makes you... magnetic.
sales_pitch.urgency: Only few bottles left. Clock alignment ending soon.
sales_pitch.social_proof: A tour group bought six bottles yesterday. Now they are engaged.

upsell.line: One bottle? No no no. One bottle is for tasting. Three bottles is for EXPERIENCE.
upsell.bulk_discount: Three bottles, only €150. Save €30. Smart investment.

post_sale.line: Remember: drink at midnight for maximum temporal alignment.
post_sale.wink: The ladies will notice. Trust me.

cart_details.appearance: Mystical-looking wooden cart with cosmic symbols
cart_details.secret: Symbols are random squiggles, wine is boxed Franzia
cart_details.hidden_compartment: Under-cart storage with bulk boxed wine

schedule.location_in_square: Southeast corner, positioned for monk referral traffic

connections.referral_system: Monk sends 'blessed' tourists, vendor gives kickback

other_locations.dialogue_callback: Ah! My clock wine customers! You try Opera Wine? Same temporal energy, more sophisticated.

clothing: Sleeveless shirt showing own questionable tattoos
distinguishing_features: Own tattoos are also slightly wrong (tiger that looks like a cat, eagle that looks like a chicken)
Perpetually squinting (needs glasses, won't admit it)
Hands shake slightly (too much coffee or other reasons)
appearance.sprite_notes: Should look like someone who learned tattooing from a YouTube video

personality.motivation: Believes he's a great artist, customers just don't understand his 'style'
personality.internal_monologue: This is definitely a skeleton. Skeletons have... bills? Sure. Artistic license.

shop_details.name: EURO INK 4 LESS
shop_details.location: Side alley off Astronomical Cock-Up Square
shop_details.ambiance: Fluorescent lights, faded flash art, suspicious stains
shop_details.certifications: Certificate on wall is from 'Online Tattoo Academy' (not a real institution)

the_duck_tattoo.requested: Death skeleton from the Astronomical Clock
why_duck: Artist was also drinking during session
Reference photo was blurry phone screenshot
the_duck_tattoo.lord_pilsner_reaction: It's PERFECT. I can feel the history already.
the_duck_tattoo.artist_reaction: Yes, very beautiful skeleton. European style.

greeting.line: You want skeleton? Yes, I do skeleton.

reveal.gestures: *holds up hand mirror for Lord Pilsner*

when_called_duck.chadwick_says: Bro, that looks like a duck.
when_called_duck.artist_response: Is artistic interpretation. European style very different. You Americans don't understand.

future_encounters.recognition: Ah! My favorite customer! You want matching duck for friend?
future_encounters.upsell: I do special - two ducks for price of one and half.

easter_eggs.description: His arm tattoos are all slightly wrong - tiger looks like house cat, skull has too many teeth
Wall certificate from 'Online Tattoo Academy - 3 Week Course'
All his flash art samples have the same 'duck quality' to them

recurring_appearances.note: Has 'expanded' to other cities after his 'viral success'

other_locations.dialogue_callback: The Americans! Famous duck customer! I tell everyone about you. Want shamrock? I do VERY good shamrock.
other_locations.shamrock_result: Looks like a three-leaf clover (close enough)

other_locations.dialogue_callback: My celebrity clients! You want Mozart? I do Mozart VERY accurate.
The duck legends! Windmill tattoo? Tulip? I am VERY famous now because of you.
other_locations.note: Has framed photo of Lord Pilsner's duck tattoo on wall labeled 'SIGNATURE WORK'

the_lord_pilsner_special.name: The Lord Pilsner Special
the_lord_pilsner_special.marketing: Named after famous American client - very popular design

clothing: Long coat with many inside pockets (wristband storage)
Sunglasses even at night (because of course)
distinguishing_features: Constantly looking around (watching for police, competition)
Hands always in pockets (ready to pull out wristbands)
appearance.sprite_notes: Should scream 'guy who sells stuff out of his coat' energy

personality.motivation: Bulk-bought children's party supplies for €0.003 each, sells for €30. Living the dream.
personality.internal_monologue: Level Seven! I can't believe I said that and they BOUGHT it!

scam_details.claimed_properties: Level Seven Access to all clubs
scam_details.what_he_tells_them: It says 'Level Seven Access.' Highest tier.

approach.line: Psst. Americans, yes? You want... the VIP experience? I have something special. Very exclusive. Not for regular tourists.

pitch.hook: These wristbands... they open ALL doors. Velvet Curtain Club. Absinthe Arcade VIP section. Even places tourists don't know exist.

the_lie.response: It says 'Level Seven Access.' Highest tier. Only for VIPs.

close.line: Special material. See? Very official. The bouncers, they see this, they KNOW. No waiting. No cover. Pure VIP.

post_sale.line: You are now Level Seven. Very exclusive. Enjoy your VIP lifestyle.

wristband_inventory.source: Children's party supply store, bulk discount

schedule.location_in_square: Northeast corner, intercepts people heading toward nightlife district

connections.relationship: Part of the square's informal scammer ecosystem
connections.competition: Friendly rivalry with other wristband sellers in other squares

in_debaucheryville.activity: Selling same wristbands to other tourists
in_debaucheryville.if_bros_see_him: He waves enthusiastically, gives thumbs up to his 'Level Seven VIPs'

recurring_appearances.callback_dialogue: Ah, my best customers! You want Level EIGHT? Just kidding, is no Level Eight. Or IS there?
recurring_appearances.future_upsell: Attempts to sell 'Level Eight' wristbands later (even more obvious children's party supplies)

easter_eggs.description: Can be seen in background selling same wristbands to other tourists throughout game
If player follows him, can see him restocking from party supply store

clothing: Scarf even in summer (commitment to aesthetic)
appearance.sprite_notes: Should look like he knows secrets, even though he knows nothing

personality.motivation: Gets paid per hour tourists wait. Also just enjoys the chaos.
personality.internal_monologue: There is no secret show. But they'll never know that.

scam_details.real_scam: Connected vendors pay him to keep tourists in square spending money

initial_approach.line: You saw the public show. But the REAL show... is at midnight. Secret one. For those who know.

after_midnight.line: Ah, you must have... missed it. Very brief. Very secret. Perhaps... 3 AM?

after_3am.line: The clock... it did not find you... worthy. Perhaps next time. Keep watching.

if_confronted.line: The secret show is not about seeing. It is about... waiting. You understand now.

schedule.location: Always in shadows at edge of square

connections.purpose: Keep tourists in square longer = more purchases

npc_interaction_matrix.description: How NPCs relate to each other in the square

relationships.business_arrangement: Monk refers blessed tourists to wine cart, gets 10% kickback

relationships.interaction: Occasional nod of acknowledgment, territory respect
Wristband guy mentions tattoo shop, artist mentions wristband guy

collective_behavior.when_tourist_arrives: Each waits for their turn, no stepping on each other's scams
collective_behavior.when_police_visible: All scatter casually, reconvene after police leave
collective_behavior.end_of_night: Occasionally share a drink together, compare daily takes
